'''Strayen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Strayen was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Strayen returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. As the Cold War continued to tax Jedi numbers, Master Strayen retired from [[Jedi instructor|teaching]] and worked exclusively as a [[Jedi recruiter|recruiter]]. Later on, a rising Jedi Padawan met with Strayen to discuss a matter of concern in which a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Flesh Raider]] known as [[Fashk]] wished to be trained to control his Force ability. They eventually concluded that they had to train him partially, as he was holding a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] boy known as [[Viyo Kobbeth]] hostage. Strayen later consulted the Jedi Council on this issue.<ref name="TOR" />
